text: Open source reactive database where queries are TypeScript code that runs inside the database
quote: Convex is the open source, reactive database where queries are TypeScript code running right in the database.

text: Provides a database, server functions and client libraries together for building live-updating apps
quote: Convex provides a database, a place to write your server functions, and client libraries. It makes it easy to build and scale dynamic live-updating apps.

text: No setup and no SQL required; app data needs are expressed in JavaScript
quote: There is nothing to set up and no need to write any SQL. Just use JavaScript to express your app's needs.

text: Optional schemas enforce the shape of stored data
quote: Though optional, schemas ensure that your data looks exactly how you want.

text: Tables are created automatically when the first document is inserted, with no upfront table creation
quote: Each table springs into existence as soon as you add the first document to it.

text: Integrates with third-party auth providers such as Clerk, WorkOS AuthKit and Auth0
quote: Clerk has great Next.js and React Native support ... WorkOS AuthKit is built for B2B apps ... Auth0 is more established with more bells and whistles

text: Convex Auth library supports sign-in with social providers, one-time email/SMS codes, or passwords
quote: you can implement auth directly in Convex with the Convex Auth library... helps you build a custom sign-up/sign-in flow via social identity providers, one-time email or SMS access codes, or via passwords.

text: Custom auth integration lets any OpenID Connect-compatible identity provider be used
quote: Custom Auth Integration allow any OpenID Connect-compatible identity provider to be used for authentication

text: Dev watcher pushes changed functions and schema to the dev deployment and regenerates TypeScript types
quote: Watches the local filesystem. When you change a function or the schema, the new versions are pushed to your dev deployment and the generated types in convex/_generated are updated.

text: End-to-end type safety catches errors, including agent hallucinations, before they ship
quote: End-to-end type safety so agent hallucinations are caught before they ship

text: Vector search over embeddings to give LLMs context and power similar-content recommendations
quote: Vector search allows you to find Convex documents similar to a provided vector... enable you to provide useful context to LLMs for AI powered applications, recommendations for similar content and more.

text: Vector indexes can include additional fields for fast filtering
quote: The names of additional fields that are indexed for fast filtering within your vector index.

text: Backend can be self-hosted using the same open-source code as the cloud service
quote: If you're excited about self-hosting, you can run the Convex backend on your own servers. Self-hosted Convex runs the open-source backend, and contains the same fully up-to-date code the cloud service uses.

text: Self-hosting is supported via Docker or a prebuilt binary
quote: You can either use Docker (recommended) or a prebuilt binary to self host Convex.

text: Self-hosted Convex works with Neon, Fly.io, Vercel, Netlify, RDS, SQLite, Postgres and more
quote: Self-hosted Convex works well with a variety of tools including Neon, Fly.io, Vercel, Netlify, RDS, Sqlite, Postgres, and more.

text: Telemetry beacon on the self-hosted backend can be disabled with a flag
quote: if you really want to disable it, you can set the --disable-beacon flag on the backend binary.

text: Public functions are exposed at HTTP endpoints that can be called to get results
quote: These HTTP endpoints allow you to call Convex functions and get the result as a value.

text: Custom HTTP actions can be defined in convex/http.ts
quote: HTTP endpoints are defined in `convex/http.ts` and require an `httpAction` decorator.

text: Node.js actions are available for server-side code
quote: Free & Starter... File storage, Text search, Vector search, Crons, Auth, Node.js actions, Health & insights dashboard, Preview deployments

text: Official MCP server provides tools for AI agents to interact with a deployment
quote: The Convex Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides several tools that allow AI agents to interact with your Convex deployment.

text: MCP server is blocked from production deployments by default as a safety measure
quote: By default, the MCP server cannot access production deployments. This is a safety measure to prevent accidental modifications to production data.

text: Agent setup guide (agent-setup.md) prepares coding agents to work with Convex
quote: Make your agent a Convex expert: Get Convex-ready by following https://www.convex.dev/agent-setup.md

text: Copyable setup prompt for coding agents that works with any model, agent or editor
quote: Set up Convex with your agent: Copy the setup prompt for your agent. Works great with any model, any agent, any editor

text: New projects can be started by asking a coding agent to create an app with Convex
quote: Starting a new project is as easy as asking your agent to create a new app with Convex.

text: Sandboxed open-source Components add complex functionality without building from scratch
quote: Convex Components are sandboxed, open-source building blocks for your app. They let you add complex functionality to your app without implementing everything from scratch.

text: ACID transactions prevent concurrent writes from corrupting data
quote: ACID transactions so concurrent writes never corrupt your data

text: Server-side data fetching is automatically cached while staying fully consistent
quote: Server-side data fetching is automatically cached with full consistency, server-side mutators are fully transactional

text: Real-time sync over WebSockets pushes changes to clients for live updates
quote: moving data between the client and server on WebSockets, state management on the client, and pushing changes for live updates.

text: Authorization rules are written in code and checked on every public request, instead of RLS
quote: This architecture lets you check every public request against any authorization rules you can define in code.

text: Public functions can check a shared secret, such as an environment variable, before running
quote: you can write public functions accessible to the internet that check a shared secret, for example from an environment variable, before doing anything else.

text: CLI runs queries, mutations or actions on the dev deployment, with --watch for live query results
quote: Run a public or internal Convex query, mutation, or action on your development deployment... Add --watch to live update the results of a query.

text: CLI command imports data from a file into a deployment
quote: `npx convex import` — Import data from a file to your deployment

text: CLI command exports deployment data to a ZIP file
quote: npx convex export — Export data from your deployment to a ZIP file

text: CLI command streams logs from a deployment
quote: `npx convex logs` — Watch logs from your deployment

text: CLI command shows health insights for a deployment
quote: `npx convex insights` — Show health insights for your deployment

text: New projects can be scaffolded with npm create convex@latest
quote: Start a new Convex project![...]`npm create convex@latest`

text: A Convex deployment can be run locally for development
quote: It's also possible to run a Convex deployment locally for development.

text: Client support for React, Next.js, Remix, TanStack Start, React Native, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, Node.js and Bun
quote: Using your favorite frameworks: React, Next.js, Remix, TanStack Start, React Native, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, Node.js, Bun

text: Client libraries for JavaScript, Python, iOS Swift, Android Kotlin and Rust
quote: Using your favorite languages: JavaScript, Python, iOS Swift, Android Kotlin, Rust

text: Indexes for fast querying and paginated queries for large datasets
quote: Fast querying with Indexes; Exposing large datasets with Paginated Queries

text: Built-in scheduler for running background workflows
quote: Convex also includes a scheduler for running background workflows, file storage for large objects, vector search, text search.

text: Cron jobs are included on Free and Starter plans
quote: Free & Starter... File storage, Text search, Vector search, Crons, Auth, Node.js actions, Health & insights dashboard, Preview deployments
